notes.title: Version 1.1: 🔥 Hot Keys! 🔥
notes.notes:
Hey ChipWits fans!

We're excited to announce the release of ChipWits Version 1.1, an update focused on improving your programming experience and squashing some annoying bugs. The big star of this release is the new Hot Keys feature.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879599/d19c35b7a616953e04df22ad3b90c23491e6331d.png"]Hot Keys in Action!


Hot Keys are Here!


You can now assign your favorite chips to keyboard keys 1 through 8. This lets you instantly place a fully-specified chip with a single keystroke, speeding up your IBOL editing like never before. The cursor will even automatically advance to the next empty slot, keeping you in the flow.

To help you get the hang of it, we've pre-assigned some hot keys for you in the first few tutorial missions. Once you're ready, they're all yours to customize, and your settings will be saved for future missions.


Input & Accessibility Improvements


We've made significant improvements to how you interact with the game. We've added better support for gamepads and some early support for touchscreens. While we're still working on making the touchscreen experience perfect, you should notice an improvement.


Squashing Bugs & Polishing Up


Finally, we've been busy fixing a number of bugs reported by the community. We've filled in some localization gaps from our initial launch, fixed audio issues where Professor Chip's beeps were too loud, and resolved a pesky bug with our radial menu.


[hr][/hr]
Full Release Notes


[code]New Features
* #963: Alt + Click to prevent radial menu from popping up on blank slot
* #1018: Set initial volume to 50%
* #1024: Gamepad: Enable dpad for selecting chips in the workshop
* #1025: Gamepad: Left controller to select chip from radial menu
* #1027: Customizable Hot Keys 1-8
* Introduce hot keys in tutorial
* Auto advance cursor when using hot key

Bug Fixes
* #897: \[RADIAL MENU]: Selecting 'Skate' you cannot highlight a direction unless you move the mouse first
* #1012: \[AUDIO]: Volume: Professor Chip's beeps do not adhere to audio level set by user
* #1013: \[AUDIO]: Cut scene audio is incredibly loud when user has audio settings set to low
* #1014: Repeat mission says palindrome but it's not
* #1026: Localize "FIRST CHIP HERE" text
* #1028: Bug: Mission localizations for validation error toasts[/code]


We hope you enjoy these updates! As always, please let us know what you think and report any new bugs you find. Happy coding!

notes.title: ChipWits Demo v0.65.4: Feature Update
notes.notes:
Highlights
This new feature release includes some bug fixes and several significant improvements, most notably:
* Ultra-wide monitor support and support for all aspect ratios
* Improved keyboard support, including more shortcut keys and "Quick Buffers"
* Top 10 scores are now available in the histogram view (as well as the ability to not share yours)
* The ability to drag the camera around with the middle mouse or Command+Left button

Press the Field Manual button during the game to see all available hotkeys

New Features
* #883: [SCORE]: Make it more clear when the player matches top score in the category
* #890: [USABILITY]: Hotkey page
* #891: Alt + arrows changes true connector direction
* #892: [HOTKEY]: PgUp, PgDn switches between SubPanels
* #906: Support for ultra-wide monitors, and improve support for all aspect ratios in game and puzzle selection screens
* #920: Drag the camera around with middle mouse or Command+Left button
* #924: Show top 10 scores in histogram view
* #929: Ask user if they want to be notified when new puzzles come out
* #931: [MANUAL]: Make it explicit when the game will open the browser to chipwits.com/docs
* #934: Show "Top", "All Equal", "Top x%", or "Bottom x%" as appropriate (and don't show "Top 0%")
* #935: Add noSpawn marker option to mission file format to prevent items from spawning on some tiles
* #937: Ctrl+Left Click should have the same behavior as right-click for computers with no right mouse button
* Improve keyboard behavior:
    * Add shortcut keys to all action menus
    * Restore selection after modal dialog
    * Ensure a default button selected when modal dialog opens
    * Select chip grid when mission starts, by default
* Quick Buffers: Alt 1-8 copies selected chips into a persistent buffer, 1-8 pastes
* Enable not submitting scores, not showing name in options. Show steam names in top 10
* Update Copyright to 2025

Bug Fixes
* #832: [DEMO]: Audio: User reported: The clicks in Video Settings" are extremely loud compared to everywhere else
* #881: BUG: Fall does not animate when speed > 16X
* #905: [DEMO]: [CRASH]: [40th Anniversary Puzzle]: Hitting escape twice while level is underway puts the game into a strange level state which eventually causes game to crash
* #906: [RESOLUTION]: On 3440x1440 resolution screen/text is cut off
* #936: [LOC]: Percentages for scoreboard show up as tofu box for some locales
* Fix animation of objective met dialog

notes.title: ChipWits Demo v0.63: 40th Anniversary Release!
notes.notes:
Happy 40th Anniversary to ChipWits! This release includes a new mission to celebrate this milestone
and a new 1-bit ChipWit model and tileset. It also improves the handling of random behavior.

Enhancements
* Add 40th Anniversary Challenge Mission
* Add 1-bit ChipWit model
* Add 1-bit tileset
* New Item: candle
* #896: More consistent and fair handling of random behavior (especially IfHeads)
* When restarting from Play mode, keep the same random number seed so the player can debug issues.
* When restarting from Edit mode, choose a new random number seed

Bug Fixes
* #900: During grace period after challenge, there is no way to play the mission
* #901: Stop updating challenge leaderboard when challenge is over
* #903: Reset fuel and damage between stages.
* #904: Fix graph rendering when there are only 8 data points
